name: Deepest Sword
author: Addicting Games
description:
Welcome to Deepest Sword, a thrilling physics-based game where you must slay a mighty dragon using a sword that grows longer with each successful strike. Navigate through challenging environments, timing your swings to get from platform to platform.

As you progress, your sword lengthens, increasing both your reach and the challenge of wielding such a massive weapon. Master the art of swordplay and strategic movement to overcome obstacles and defeat the dragon in this epic battle.
